iWant: every bundle to refuse unless the RCF suite is recorded green on the base head
soThat: no Build starts on a red base, and verified never blocks a Build
title: The stage-keeper cannot start a Build on a red base

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given a fixture project at a clean committed HEAD B whose FBS-002 is next actionable and whose FBS-001 is complete and not verified, and a record from rcf build base-suite --command "node --test test/rcf" --out <scratch>/base.json reading green at B, when rcf build bundle --next --base-suite <scratch>/base.json runs, then it exits 0 and emits the FBS-002 bundle: a complete-not-verified spec never holds the queue.

[failure] Given the same fixture and no --base-suite, rcf build bundle --next exits 4 with stderr "backstop: base suite not recorded; run rcf build base-suite --command \"<suite>\" --out <file> on the base and pass --base-suite <file>" and emits no bundle; given a malformed record file it exits 2 naming the file.

[failure] Given a green record made at commit A and HEAD now at B (a later commit), rcf build bundle --next --base-suite <file> exits 4 with stderr "backstop: base suite recorded at <A7>, base is <B7>; record it again".

[failure] Given a record at B with exitCode 1 and tap fail 3, rcf build bundle --next --base-suite <file> exits 4 with stderr "backstop: base suite red at <B7>: exit 1, 3 failing; no Build starts until the RCF suite is green on the base"; the same record refuses rcf build bundle FBS-002 (explicit id) and an amend bundle the same way.

[must-not] No flag emits a bundle on a red or missing base-suite record: --override "<reason>" (which satisfies only the freeze gate), --strict and --format change nothing about the refusal; and the backstop never reads executionStatus verified (a fixture where every spec is complete and none verified, with a green record, bundles).

[edge] Given a dirty working tree, rcf build base-suite exits 4 with stderr "base-suite refused: working tree is dirty; record the suite on a committed base"; given --out rcf/base.json it exits 2 (a record never lands in the chain tree); given a suite command printing no TAP, the record carries tap null and green follows the exit code alone.

[non-functional] Given a green record for HEAD, rcf build bundle --next adds no more than 100 milliseconds to the same bundle without the backstop and never spawns the suite command (a spawn seam records none), so the suite's cost (166 seconds for this repository's suite at concurrency 6, the typical case) is paid once per base head by rcf build base-suite.
